view_frame: The drawing presents two views of a stepped round knob. The left view is the Front view (XZ plane), showing the profile of the knob's cross-section. The right view is the Right view (YZ plane), showing the mirrored profile, confirming rotational symmetry about the Z-axis. The Top view (XY plane) is not explicitly drawn but is implied to be concentric circles corresponding to the steps. The Z-axis represents the height/depth of the knob, and the X-axis represents the width (diameter).

features.evidence: The bottom-most horizontal segment in the Front view (left) and Right view (right) represents the base of the knob.
The narrower vertical section in the middle of the profile in both views.
The top-most horizontal segment in the Front view (left) and Right view (right) represents the head of the knob.

connections: knob_base connects to knob_neck at z = ASSUMED_BASE_HEIGHT
knob_neck connects to knob_head at z = ASSUMED_BASE_HEIGHT + ASSUMED_NECK_HEIGHT
edit_rules: Changing ASSUMED_BASE_RADIUS affects the diameter of the base.
Changing ASSUMED_BASE_HEIGHT affects the height of the base and the starting Z of the neck.
Changing ASSUMED_NECK_RADIUS affects the diameter of the neck.
Changing ASSUMED_NECK_HEIGHT affects the height of the neck and the starting Z of the head.
Changing ASSUMED_HEAD_RADIUS affects the diameter of the head.
Changing ASSUMED_HEAD_HEIGHT affects the height of the head.
